title-group.article-title: Graph Neural Networks for Protein Structure Prediction

abstract.p: We develop a graph neural network architecture that predicts protein backbone coordinates from sequence with sub-angstrom accuracy.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Protein structure prediction has been transformed by deep learning approaches. AlphaFold2 (Jumper et al., 2021) achieved experimental-level accuracy.

sec.title: Network Architecture
sec.p: Our model uses an equivariant graph neural network with SE(3) symmetry.

sec.title: Training Data
sec.p: We trained on 150,000 structures from the PDB, filtered for resolution better than 2.0 Å.
